_note: Investment criteria for the decision box (report top and Pencil calculator) and the unit-by-unit sellout. Every value is an editable assumption. Kept apart from cost-assumptions so editing a criterion never changes the priced budget.

targetMarginOnCost.label: Target developer profit, share of total development cost
targetMarginOnCost.sourceLabel: Assumption, edit me (a common for-sale developer target is 15–20% of cost)

minContingency.label: Minimum contingency, share of hard cost

maxLtc.label: Maximum construction loan, share of cost (LTC)
maxLtc.sourceLabel: Assumption, edit me (construction lenders commonly lend 75–80% of cost)

closingIntervalMonths.label: Months between closings after the first
closingIntervalMonths.sourceLabel: Assumption, edit me (one closing every 2 months; not a market study)

bedroomBands.label: Bedrooms by finished size per home
bedroomBands.sourceLabel: Assumption, edit me (size bands, not a floor plan)
